'''The travelers''' is the name given to those who walk among the stars. Those being the [[Hearthian]] astronauts, [[Solanum]], the last [[Nomai]] of her clan, and [[Prisoner|the Prisoner]], an [[The Stranger's inhabitants|inhabitant of the Stranger]] who let the signal of the [[Eye of the Universe|Eye]] transmit for the last time. Each of the travelers plays a music instrument.
